changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, 0, '数据采集', 'data_collection', 1, '/collection', 'Layout', NULL, 'Collection', 6, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection');

INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection' LIMIT 1), '数据源管理', 'collector_datasource', 2, '/collection/datasource', 'resource/DataSourceManagement', 'collector:datasource:list', 'Connection', 1, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'collector_datasource');

INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection' LIMIT 1), '表资源管理', 'collector_table_resource', 2, '/collection/table', 'resource/TableResourceManagement', 'collector:table:list', 'DataBoard', 2, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'collector_table_resource');

INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection' LIMIT 1), 'API管理', 'collector_api', 2, '/collection/api', 'resource/ApiManagement', 'collector:api:list', 'Link', 3, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'collector_api');

INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) SELECT 1, id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code IN ('data_collection', 'collector_datasource', 'collector_table_resource', 'collector_api') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = 1 AND menu_id = sys_menu.id);
